steps.code:
# Get all received transactions for May 2023
all_received = []
page = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=access_token, direction='received', min_created_at='2023-05-01', max_created_at='2023-05-31', page_limit=20, page_index=page)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_received.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page += 1

print(f"Total received transactions: {len(all_received)}")
print(all_received)
